The Global Nuclear Power Tracker supplies operating capacity and projects under construction, in pre-construction, or announced \citep{gem2026nuclear}. Reported commissioning dates are used where available; otherwise, availability dates are assigned by project status. This prescribed pipeline yields national capacity floors of 106.8, 146.3, 185.8, and 185.8~GW in 2030, 2040, 2050, and 2060. Announced projects are therefore scenario commitments rather than assured completions. Separate provincial development ceilings sum to 110, 205, 300, and 300~GW. The 2030 ceiling uses a national planning benchmark \citep{nea2026nuclearbenchmark}; the longer-term ceilings are study assumptions rather than binding policy targets. Nuclear operation retains minimum-output and ramping restrictions, with a 60-year lifetime for new investment.
